historical_transitions.summary: Frankencoin (ZCHF) v1 deployed as a non-proxy contract (no EIP-1967 implementation slot, 15,254-char runtime bytecode). Constructor fixes MIN_APPLICATION_PERIOD = 1,209,600 s (14 days) as an immutable; MIN_FEE = 1,000 ZCHF is a constant; reserve() = FPS Equity 0x1bA26788dfDe592fec8bcB0Eaff472a42BE341B2 whose QUORUM constant is 200 bps (2%). Runtime bytecode returned at blocks 18,451,600, 22,000,000 and latest is byte-identical.

Bootstrap minter grant via initialize() while totalSupply was 0: MinterApplied for Minting Hub 0x7546762fDB1a6d9146b33960545C3f6394265219 with applicationPeriod 0 and fee 0 (followed 35 blocks later by the XCHF Bridge in tx 0x611da737). This zero-delay path is self-disabling once supply exists; every later application paid the 14-day / 1,000 ZCHF minimum.

MinterDenied('nice try') for 'XCHF Manager' 0xAD309aecF82FbBe26Eb126c0389f744243092677, applied at block 19,069,309 (tx 0xa3dc917b) with a 14-day period; vetoed 986 blocks (~3.3 h) later by a qualified FPS holder. minters(0xAD30...) is 0 today, confirming the veto path of the immutable governance worked.

Protocol v2 rollout without any proxy upgrade: Savings (0x3BF301B0e2003E75A3e86AB82bD1EFF6A9dFB2aE, block 21,281,096), Roller (0xAD0107D3Da540Fd54b1931735b65110C909ea6B6, block 21,281,102) and Minting Hub V2 (0xDe12B620A8a714476A97EfD14E6F7180Ca653557, this tx) were each added as new minter modules with 14-day application periods and 1,000 ZCHF fees, leaving the v1 ZCHF bytecode untouched.

Lookalike minter application vetoed: 0x3e44A18499a298877F989117403c16084E4ff6c1 (an EOA with empty code at the application block #25,199,256; it later acquired an EIP-7702 delegation, code 0xef0100e5f1... at block 26,452,000) called suggestMinter on itself at block 25,199,256 (tx 0xde1c764b) with the message 'AllUnity CHFAU Stablecoin Bridge*', mimicking the legitimate StablecoinBridge 0x3e445fF4dDDF0Ff8AE7458C9746ED80bD664F6c1 applied on 2026-04-30 (prefix 0x3e44, suffix f6c1). Denied 54 blocks (~11 min) later; minters() for the lookalike is 0, while the genuine bridge has been active since 2026-05-14.

UniswapAmplifier 0xa1304E5aaF83Cdb7c2B367f50b99bB0647eD8c58 ('Uniswap Amplifier 2027-04-01 2.5M') applied with a 14-day period; minters() returns validity start 1788434555 (2026-09-03 11:22 UTC) = application + exactly 14 days, matching the immutable MIN_APPLICATION_PERIOD. The exact deployed source was public before admission: the Blockscout-verified sources of 0xa1304E5a (all 10 project files, CRLF-normalised) are byte-identical to Frankencoin-ZCHF/Frankencoin commit 98a0b29e8179a36cf7baa18fd5598bc96ba75df1 (dated 2026-08-20T08:33:38Z, on main). The contract was deployed at block 25,795,552 (tx 0x0f48d1fe, 2026-08-20T09:51:47Z) and applied at block 25,796,002 (11:22:35Z), so the admitted code was published ~2.8 h before the application and ~14 days before it could mint. Non-comment code has been unchanged since commit 4c74efad (2026-07-30T09:39:35Z); earlier drafts date back to b75b127e (2026-06-23) but differ substantially from the deployed version.

Governance-layer migration: Frankencoin Shares (FCS) wrapper 0xDb861830D9Ae2d1fCF99fA0cfd3973de382B0B5b deployed (non-proxy). FCS wraps legacy FPS and exercises the underlying FPS1 votes through governance modules (MinterGovernance etc.) that use Governance.sol QUORUM = 100 bps; the legacy FPS1 Equity contract and its 200 bps quorum remain unchanged and still gate direct ZCHF.denyMinter calls.

First observed use of the FCS enforcement path: plain EOA 0x52Ab424b99FfeB870a9CA3BEe1bde9Ad64b5c83E applied itself as a minter ('liquidity provision', block 26,311,571, tx 0x1c96e4d9) directly on ZCHF, bypassing the MinterGovernance announcement. MinterGovernance 0x4655529A4bf8c26a97C2B7F6C044B69a2f98E73c.denyUnannouncedMinter() vetoed it 3,475 blocks (~11.6 h) later with message 'FCS'; minters() for the EOA is 0.

evidence_sources.claim_summary: First versioned governance doc (commit 5bb97f1a, the day the gitbook repo was created): proposals cost at least 1000 ZCHF, new minting modules pass after at least 14 days unless vetoed, veto needs v > 2% of votes. Matches MIN_FEE, MIN_APPLICATION_PERIOD = 1,209,600 s and FPS1 QUORUM = 200 on-chain (verified_aligned). No versioned docs exist before 2024-04-06, so alignment is not claimed for 2023-10-28..2024-04-05.

GITBOOK-65 rewrite (2024-06-08) keeps the same three parameters: fee at least 1000 ZCHF, minting modules open at least 14 days, veto power for more than 2% of votes. Later commits 09de9233 (2024-10-17), daaea88f (2024-11-14) and e99b3980 (2025-07-24) still state 2%.

Rewrote governance.md and fps-reference.md: legacy FPS quorum 'is no longer 2%' and direct FPS holders use the shared 1% (100 bps) quorum. The deployed FPS1 Equity (ZCHF.reserve()) is immutable with QUORUM = 200 bps.

Governance.sol QUORUM = 100 (strict >) applies to the new Equity/FCS code path only. The 2023 FPS1 Equity source verified on Blockscout for 0x1bA26788dfDe592fec8bcB0Eaff472a42BE341B2 still has QUORUM = 200 (inclusive).
The live docs still say both FCS-based and direct legacy FPS actions use the same shared 1% quorum, so the gap is unrepaired as of this dossier.

gap_windows.summary: From the first versioned governance doc (gitbook 5bb97f1a, block ~19,598,578, 2024-04-06) until the 2026-09-28 rewrite, docs (14-day minimum for minting modules, 1,000 ZCHF fee, 2% veto quorum) matched the immutable on-chain constants and the replayed transition receipts. The 2023-10-28..2024-04-05 period has no versioned docs and is not scored.

Docs state the legacy FPS quorum is a shared 1% while the immutable FPS1 Equity behind ZCHF.reserve() enforces 2%. A holder with 1-2% who calls ZCHF.denyMinter directly reverts with NotQualified. Still open at block 26,452,000.

executive_risk_memo: Frankencoin's canonical mainnet ZCHF (0xB58E61C3098d85632Df34EecfB899A1Ed80921cB) has carried byte-identical non-proxy runtime code from deployment at block 18,451,518 (2023-10-28) to block 26,452,000, so the 2023-2026 control-plane trajectory is not a story of implementation upgrades but of minter admission. Across all 17 MinterApplied events (full census, reproducible with eth_getLogs on address 0xB58E61C3098d85632Df34EecfB899A1Ed80921cB, topic0 0x97326258efdae63280617ca33884e507791c2abeed7b82acd77f1853394ef94b, fromBlock 18451518 to latest; MinterDenied topic0 0xd60c86e83346fdbe3124cb7d1cba32973a9f62d05c4ec801bfe6c09d10380381 returns exactly 5 logs, at blocks 18,465,752, 19,070,295, 20,820,106, 25,199,310 and 26,315,046), the two bootstrap minters used the zero-delay initialize() path while supply was zero; every one of the following 15 applications met the immutable 14-day minimum period (the first, a 2023 test, chose 30 days) and paid the 1,000 ZCHF minimum fee, and five were vetoed: a 2023 test, 'XCHF Manager' (~3.3 h), 'Vault' (~6 min), a lookalike EOA (later EIP-7702-delegated) impersonating the AllUnity CHFAU bridge (~11 min), and an EOA vetoed through the new FCS MinterGovernance.denyUnannouncedMinter path (~11.6 h). The veto layer has therefore been demonstrably live and fast, but it is the only protection: an unvetoed application becomes an unrestricted minter after 14 days, so safety depends on continuous monitoring by at least one holder above quorum. The open documentation gap concerns exactly that quorum. Since commit a1322816 (2026-09-28) the GitBook states that legacy FPS 'is no longer 2%' and that direct FPS actions use the shared 1% Governance.sol quorum. That is true of the FCS modules and of the v2 source tree, but the immutable FPS1 Equity contract wired as ZCHF.reserve() (0x1bA26788dfDe592fec8bcB0Eaff472a42BE341B2) still enforces QUORUM = 200 bps with an inclusive comparison, so a holder with between 1% and 2% who follows the docs and calls ZCHF.denyMinter directly will revert; such holders must route through FCS. The gap has been open for 52 days with no correction (unrepaired_open). Engineering bench (Frankencoin-ZCHF/Frankencoin, default branch main, GitHub commits API since=2025-11-19T00:00:00Z): 152 commits; 96 touch contracts/ or test/ (commits_12m_contracts) and the other 56 touch only frontend, scripts, docs or config. The 152 commits come from four non-bot GitHub accounts (luziusmeisser 79, samclassix 67, mathewmeconry 4, jonk93 2 = human_contributors_12m 4); the 96 contract/test commits split luziusmeisser 69, samclassix 26, mathewmeconry 1. bus_factor is defined here as the smallest number of accounts that together authored more than 50% of the contract/test commits; luziusmeisser alone authored 69/96 (about 72%), so bus_factor = 1. New modules were public before admission: the verified source of UniswapAmplifier 0xa1304E5a is byte-identical (ignoring CRLF) to commit 98a0b29e8179a36cf7baa18fd5598bc96ba75df1 (2026-08-20T08:33:38Z, https://github.com/Frankencoin-ZCHF/Frankencoin/commit/98a0b29e8179a36cf7baa18fd5598bc96ba75df1), ~2.8 h before its MinterApplied at block 25,796,002 (11:22:35Z) and 14 days before it could mint; its non-comment logic has been public since 4c74efad (2026-07-30). Documentation alignment is scored only from the first versioned governance doc (gitbook commit 5bb97f1a, 2024-04-06; repo created that day) and its 2024-06-08 rewrite 3f655183; no versioned docs exist for 2023-10-28..2024-04-05. Overall risk: low upgrade risk (no admin, no proxy), medium governance-liveness risk, and a documentation inaccuracy that could cost a would-be vetoer time during a 14-day window.
